steps.content: I'll explain the details to you later. We have to deal with this crisis at hand first.

My team will take care of the enemies coming from the front and start the main base station. They might attack us from behind; I hope you can intercept them. You can make use of all the <color=#fb9259>supporting machinery</color> here.
He takes out a gadget embedded with a blue crystal, puts it in your palm, and asks you to hold it tightly.

It's a <color=#fb9259>Mania shield</color> for individual use. The force field created by the Hypercubes inside can temporarily alleviate the mental strain the shackles put on you, and at least allow your Sinners to get back in fighting shape.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Captain! The enemies are coming; the nearest ones are twenty meters away!
C formation. Covering fire in seven seconds!
He turns to you to give his final words.
Remember, no matter what happens, don't be swayed by your enemies, and don't worry about us and get distracted.
It's our responsibility to protect you. And your only job is to protect yourself.
Then he picks up his ax, and charges at the crowd of enemies amid a cacophony of gunfire.
